items.description: Help a user find, judge, apply for and rehearse for jobs. Four modes: discover (what is out there worth looking at), assess (whether this posting is worth applying to), apply (build and pressure-test the application), interview (rehearse and debrief). Use whenever the user wants to search for roles, judge their fit for a posting, tailor or optimize their CV/resume to a job, build a resume from scratch, write a cover/motivation letter, check whether an application is strong enough, or practise an interview — e.g. "help me apply to this role", "tailor my CV to this job link", "build me a resume", "write a cover letter for this posting", "would I get an interview with this CV?", "is this job worth applying to?", "find me MRI reconstruction roles in the Netherlands", "run a mock interview for this posting". Outputs Markdown, PDF (LaTeX), and .docx. Never fabricates experience — honest reframing only — and never predicts an interview or offer probability.

latestVersion.changelog:
Job-hunt skill version 1.0.0

- Adds comprehensive job search assistance across four modes: discover, assess, apply, and interview.
- Delivers client-facing reports and application documents in both Markdown and PDF formats, with verified delivery steps.
- Enforces a strict no-fabrication rule — application materials only reframe the user's real experience.
- Implements a review loop using three independent evaluation agents (ATS, Recruiter/HR, Hiring Manager) before application delivery.
- Presents clear mode selection and hand-off guidance, ensuring users explicitly choose each step in their job search process.
